أبتهج (form VIII)
# أَبْتَهِجُ (ʔabtahiju) /ʔab.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# أُبْتَهَجُ (ʔubtahaju) /ʔub.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# أَبْتَهِجَ (ʔabtahija) /ʔab.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# أُبْتَهَجَ (ʔubtahaja) /ʔub
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
